templates.empty: Pick a profile on the right: its card fills in here.

dev.title: Coding partner
dev.description: Fixes, reviews and ships in your repositories.

blank.title: Start from scratch
blank.description: A generalist you shape as you go.

interview.title: Let’s set up your automation
interview.subtitle: Five questions, and your agent knows what to do, with what and when.
interview.q1: What do I automate for you?
interview.q4: Before an important action, what do I do?
interview.q5: Where do I let you know?
interview.toolsHint: The ones not connected yet will be offered right after.

ask.title: Ask me first
ask.description: Recommended to start: you approve every send or change.

report.title: Act, tell me after
report.description: For routine work: it acts and reports back.

sheet.title: Configure your agent
sheet.subtitle: Every setting stays editable in its profile.
sheet.roleHint: It stays your main agent, the pilot: this only sets what it focuses on.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator / pilot
orchestrator.description: Splits work into tasks and delegates.

code.title: Coder
code.description: Writes and changes your project’s code.

sheet.worktree: One isolated git worktree per code task
sheet.worktreeDetail: It works beside your branch, never in it.

perm.acceptEdits: Accept file edits, ask for the rest
perm.auto: Auto: Rooks’s classifier decides, a card only when unsure
perm.bypassPermissions: Allow everything, no checks at all

sheet.bypassWarning: No approval card at all: it can do anything on this machine.
sheet.rulesPlaceholder: E.g. answer in English, never push without asking.

signin.title: Welcome back
signin.subtitle: Rooks has a new look. Sign in with your Rooks account to continue.

mascot.title: Meet {name}'s mascot
mascot.subtitle: New in this version: every agent has a mascot that shows what it is doing — thinking, working, waiting for you. Dress {name} as you like.
mascot.later: You can change it any time in the agent's Avatar tab.
mascot.failed: The look could not be saved. Try again, or choose “Not now”.

autonomous.title: An agent can run a mission
autonomous.body: Give an agent a mission, a time, or a trigger. It uses its skills and tools, keeps what it learns, and reports when the work is done.

teams.title: Agents can share a task
teams.body: One agent plans, one writes, one reviews. The task moves on the board, and you can talk to them together.

projects.title: A project keeps its agents
projects.body: An agent outside a project can work anywhere. An agent in a project stays there, with that project's rules and memory.

connected.title: Mail, calendar, and plugins
connected.body: Connectors bring in mail, calendar, and other tools. Workflows chain steps. Plugins add the rest.
